companion_note: The proof-gate checklist's item 0 (frame-1-reference-anchored) is this pipeline's Step E frame-1 gate rule; it is a delivery check, not a vision-diagnosis item, so it is not duplicated here.
derived_from: show/production/tooling/proof-gate/audit-checklist.json (landed by PR #489 with delivery_gate.py) is the 20-point audit OF RECORD - the delivery gate's data. This file is the same audit re-expressed for the vision-DIAGNOSIS step (per-item check questions + fail signatures a vision model can judge from art and frames), plus the four v5 drawn-gate items (21-24) the diagnosis pass also judges. One audit, two consumers. If the two files ever disagree on the 20 items, the proof-gate file wins and this one is corrected to match.

items.check: On a side-moving body, is the face a front portrait (both eyes, front nose and mouth, gaze at the viewer instead of along the direction of travel)?
items.fail_signature: Both eyes visible and symmetric on a profile body; gaze out of the screen.

items.check: Is the torso the front view (both straps, chest details spread across the front, front placket/buttons) while the legs are in profile?
items.fail_signature: Symmetric chest furniture on a body that is supposedly side-on; the figure reads profile only from the waist down.

items.check: Is there a visible notch or gap cut where the head meets the collar?
items.fail_signature: A step or bite in the silhouette at the jaw-to-collar junction.

items.check: Does the hair keep its front-view arrangement (a tail hanging over the chest as in the portrait; the second tail lost behind/into the backpack)?
items.fail_signature: Hair mass reads as the front portrait's hair pasted onto a side body.

items.check: Does the backpack read as a flat dark rectangle slab stuck to the back instead of a rounded side mass with its strap over the shoulder?
items.fail_signature: Hard rectangular edges; no side volume.

items.check: Is the near arm a stiff diagonal plank across the torso - no visible hand, no authored swing in opposition to the legs?
items.fail_signature: Arm angle identical or arbitrary across poses; reads as a sash/seatbelt, not an arm.

items.check: Does the planted (support) shoe face the viewer head-on - the front shoe pointing out of the screen - while the trailing shoe points along the direction of travel?
items.fail_signature: Two feet pointing in two different directions in the same pose; also covers the v5 pixel test: the drawn shoe's toe direction measured in pixels against travel.

items.check: Do the high-point poses lift the free leg parade-high instead of passing low, the way a walk passes?
items.fail_signature: Knee and foot clearance at poses 3/7 visibly higher than a walk's passing position.

items.check: Does the far arm exist at all? A walking figure in profile shows near and far arms, offset.
items.fail_signature: Exactly one arm in every pose.

items.check: Do hair clips and scrunchies sit ON the hair mass in profile-correct positions, attached - or do they float as front-view ornaments / detached bobbles in space?
items.fail_signature: A scrunchie or clip visibly separated from the hair it belongs to.

items.check: Do far-side features (second ear, earring, far scrunchie) appear at front-face positions on a profile head?
items.fail_signature: Both-side furniture on a one-side head.

items.check: Do carried waist items (Mochiko's three capsule jars) recede in profile - near full, far ones overlapping and partial - instead of hanging in a front row at one depth with their contents facing the viewer? Is any jar buried behind the arm in any pose?
items.fail_signature: Three equal, front-facing jars in a row; a jar half-hidden behind the arm slab.

items.check: Is the skirt the front skirt (symmetric pleats, straight front hem) sitting over profile legs, identical in every pose, with a hard slash where a leg solve crosses it?
items.fail_signature: Skirt silhouette is a front silhouette; zero sway across the cycle; a diagonal cut across the pleats.

items.check: Can near and far legs be told apart at the crossing/passing poses (far-side treatment: slightly darker, marginally smaller/higher)? And is any leg surface broken by a hard seam step across the thigh where a two-bone solve joins?
items.fail_signature: Same flat tone and same shoe size on both legs; crossings read tangled; the far shoe reads in front. A visible horizontal step across a thigh.

items.check: Does the hair (tails included) carry secondary motion - lag and settle behind the stride - or is it pixel-identical in every pose?
items.fail_signature: Hair mass identical across all poses of the cycle.

items.check: Does the face change at all across the cycle - at minimum a blink placed off the contact frames (cycle longer than ~3 s)?
items.fail_signature: Same expression, open eyes, every frame.

items.check: Is the head (or any part) anisotropically scaled versus the canon proportions (e.g. compressed to 0.82 of its width)?
items.fail_signature: Head-to-body ratio differs from the canon reference; face narrower than drawn.

items.check: Is there light fringe/halo along cut edges, visible against dark grounds?
items.fail_signature: Pale edging pixels around hair, legs, or pack on a dark background - inspect poses on black AND on white.

items.check: Is the head seated INTO the collar, or perched on top of it with a bare wedge of neck showing between jaw and collar?
items.fail_signature: A tan/skin wedge gap at the neck in any pose, worst at the recoils.

items.check: At the recoil poses: does the support knee fold FORWARD under load, does the body height actually drop to its lowest at recoil, and does the torso participate (small lean into travel, counter-rotation against the hips, head steadier than torso) instead of sliding as a rigid block?
items.fail_signature: Support knee bows backward; raised leg tangles; torso/head height and tilt identical across all poses.

items.check: Does the support foot plant and STICK - at the ground line in every support pose, with zero glide (support-foot velocity ~0 px/slot while planted)?
items.fail_signature: Only a minority of poses touching ground; support glides forward or backward (moonwalk signature in either direction).

items.check: Does the DRAWN shin fold back behind the knee line during swing (measured in pixels on the rendered pose, not on the skeleton)?
items.fail_signature: Shin leans toward travel at nearly every pose; knee bows off the hip-to-ankle line; the walk reads backwards whichever way it is played.

items.check: In a walk, is at least one foot on the ground in every pose (support 8/8)?
items.fail_signature: Any pose with both feet off the ground - that is hop grammar, not a walk.

items.check: Are contact/stick measurements calibrated on the TOE-END (last-contact point) of the support shoe, not the shoe centroid?
items.fail_signature: Centroid calibration re-creates the backward-knee read in miniature even when the drawing is right.

name: The 20-point structural defect audit (owner-caught, 2026-10-28)
origin: Owner viewing of the v7 canon-art walk proof (Mochiko). First pass named 7 defects; the owner caught that the list was incomplete ('I saw like 10 more'); the completed audit covers ALL 8 poses at full size plus clip frames and numbers 20 items. Doro's record, 2026-10-28. Items 21-24 are the original v5 drawn-diagnosis items (workspace ep01-ed-gag/work/v5/DIAGNOSIS.md), carried as drawn-gate items in the same checklist.
use: Step A (DIAGNOSE) of the generated-turnaround pipeline: the vision model is given the input art (poses or frames) plus this checklist and must return, for every item, PASS / FAIL / NOT VISIBLE with the frame or pose it judged. A partial audit is never reported as complete. Any FAIL routes the piece to Step B (TURNAROUND) instead of cutout assembly.
verdict_rule: The diagnosis reports per-item verdicts only. It never grades the character (grading law: wrong character = FAIL, judged by the owner's eye at the gates in Step E). A FAIL on any of items 1-20 means the art may not be assembled into a cutout puppet; it routes to Step B (TURNAROUND) or back to a drawn profile sheet.
